name: echo-apply-workspace
description: Echo Apply AI Career Agent & Resume Tailoring Workspace

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "powershell -Command .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npx -y concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "powershell -Command .venv/Scripts/pytest backend/tests" "npm run test --prefix frontend"
